headlines.title: Bloom Energy CEO Shrugs Off Oracle Force Majeure Worries, Says Bloom Boxes Are 'Fungible'
headlines.summary: In an interview with Bloomberg TV, CEO KR Sridhar explained that unlike large power plants, Bloom boxes are “fungible,” so a project delay would not be a concern.

headlines.title: Oracle data center deal could lower We Energies electric bills
headlines.summary: Oracle said its plan to purchase nuclear power could save We Energies customers $300 million in fuel costs between 2027 and 2033.

headlines.title: Oracle Has the Biggest Upside of Any Megacap Right Now: 54%
headlines.summary: Oracle's cloud business is growing faster than it has in years, yet the stock has been cut nearly in half. Our model finds a jarring disconnect between what the business is doing and what the market is pricing in.

headlines.title: Secure File Transfer Market Forecasts Growth from $5.69B (2026) to $8.34B by 2031, Profiling IBM, Fortra, OPSWAT, Axway & Oracle
headlines.summary: The global secure file transfer (SFT) market is forecast to grow from USD 5.69 billion in 2026 to USD 8.34 billion by 2031, registering an 8.0% CAGR. Growth is driven by stricter data protection regulations, cyber threats, hybrid work, multi-cloud adoption, and demand for encrypted, automated, compliance-ready file transfers. Healthcare and SMEs will record the fastest growth, while system-to-system transfer will remain the largest segment.

headlines.title: GE Vernova (GEV) vs. Quanta Services (PWR): Which AI Power Stock Has More Room to Run?
headlines.summary: The AI boom is creating a problem that has little to do with chips. Data centers need enormous amounts of electricity, but generating, transmitting, and connecting that power can take years. That is turning power infrastructure into one of the most important parts of the AI investment cycle. GE Vernova Inc.

description: Oracle Corporation offers products and services that build, run and support enterprise information technology frameworks worldwide. Its Oracle cloud software as a service offering includes various cloud software applications, including Oracle Fusion cloud enterprise resource planning ERP, Oracle Fusion cloud enterprise performance management EPM, Oracle Fusion cloud supply chain and manufacturing management SCM, Oracle Fusion cloud human capital management HCM, and NetSuite applications suite, Oracle Health applications, as well as Oracle Fusion Sales, Service, and Marketing. The company also offers cloud-based industry solutions for various industries; Oracle cloud license and on-premise license; and Oracle license support services. In addition, it provides cloud and license business' infrastructure technologies, such as the Oracle Database and MySQL Database; Java, a software development language; and middleware, including development tools and others. The company's cloud and license business' infrastructure technologies also comprise cloud-based compute, storage, and networking capabilities; and Oracle autonomous database, as well as AI, Internet-of-Things, machine learning, digital assistant, and blockchain. Further, it provides hardware products and other hardware-related software offerings, including Oracle engineered systems, enterprise servers, storage solutions, industry-specific hardware, virtualization software, operating systems, management software, and related hardware support services, and consulting and advanced customer services. It markets and sells its cloud, license, hardware, support, and services offerings directly to businesses in various industries, government agencies, and educational institutions, as well as through indirect channels. Oracle Corporation has a strategic alliance with Metron, Inc. The company was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Austin, Texas.
